description:
Returns the complete record of one tender: all fields of get_tender plus AI-structured sections (description, criteria, …), a Q&A list (e.g. 'Is a security clearance required?'), topic facets and the list of procurement documents (file names, sizes, MIME types, download status). Intended for requests where the user asks which documents a tender has, or wants a structured summary or the Q&A of the tender documents. The files themselves are not returned; they are available via the portal link (`procedure_room_url` or `detail_url`). `assistant_ready` = true means the documents were downloaded and analysed, so `sections`, `qa` and `eligibility_summary` are filled; when false they are empty. `documents[].download_status`: ok = stored at Overfit, pending = not fetched yet, failed/skipped = could not be fetched. Input: the numeric notice_id (field `notice_id` in search_tenders and get_tender results, field `id` in list_tenders results), not the string uid. Limits: 30 requests per 10 minutes, 200 per day per IP (shared with get_tender).

Example user questions: "Welche Unterlagen gibt es für diese Ausschreibung?"; "Gibt es eine strukturierte Zusammenfassung der Vergabeunterlagen?"; "Welche Fragen und Antworten sind zu dieser Ausschreibung bekannt?"

notice_id.description: Numeric notice ID (not the string uid): field 'notice_id' in search_tenders / get_tender results, field 'id' in list_tenders results.
